subject: MSStats skyline plugin : exporting data used for graphic chart generation

messages.author: e9e48f1f179f3fb7
messages.subject: MSStats skyline plugin : exporting data used for graphic chart generation
parts:
Dear all,

I'm using MSstats from skyline plugin. I would like to get the values used by MSstats for generating the different graphic charts (for example, the values used for the QC chart generation)

Is it possible ?

Best regards,

Adrien.

messages.author: 085b00b73e467d88
messages.subject: Re: MSStats skyline plugin : exporting data used for graphic chart generation
parts:
Hi Adrien,

When you run each of the MSstats in Skyline, a corresponding output file containing the values for visualization will be generated under the same folder: 

MSstats QC - dataProcessedData.csv

MSstats Group Comparison - TestingResult.csv

MSstats Design Sample Size - SampleSizeCalculation.csv

Best,
Tsung-Heng
